commit.message:
feat(browser): experience-driven fleet — Outcome River credit ring feeds idle grace + reliability-ordered retirement (T3-9)

- rsi-outcome-river: bounded recent-credits ring (64 entries, ids+sign only)
  appended at credit time, persisted durably, snapshot exposes last 32.
- fleet-experience-signal (new): pure projection over the ring — recent
  positive velocity (60min window, saturation 24) -> grace cycles (max +4);
  per-agent/per-role success rates; all authority fences false.
- fleet-elastic-governor: experience grace extends the idle shrink horizon;
  retirement re-ranked by role reliability BEFORE the bound is applied
  (worst first, unknown between bands via neutral 0.5 midpoint, proven-good
  keeps its agents even when newest; stable sort keeps newest-first within
  a band). Demand math, warm floor and scheduler authority unchanged.
- devos cycle: derives the signal from state.rsi_outcome_river each
  reconcile; missing signal keeps every pre-T3 behavior exact.
- tests: 10 new (signal derivation, aggregation, saturation/clamps, grace
  hold, bound-after-ranking regression, malformed-signal clamps, ring sign
  + restart durability). Full suite 3290 pass / 0 fail / 2 skipped.
